correctness.rationale: Read frozen RESULT.md, derivation and check.py. Positivity and P=S+I bound follow from S<=max(A,S0) and P'<=K(A+delta)-delta P. In any low-S episode (S_n<delta e^{-AT}/(2beta)), I_{n+1}<=e^{-delta T/2}I_n and S_{n+1}/S_n>=e^{delta T/(2beta)}e^{-beta TI_n}; geometric summation plus one-step entry bound yields a strictly positive susceptible floor for each positive solution. Exactly log L derivative = -beta^2 I for L=q^{beta tau/T} S^beta I; at a pulse q^beta is offset by phase reset. L decreases to zero (a positive limit would force I bounded below), so I->0 by S floor. Logistic pulse comparison gives S->s uniformly in phase. Integrating (1/L)'=beta^2 q^{-beta tau/T}S^{-beta} across periods and Cesaro yields nL->1/C and the explicit I profile. Stable linear equation for z=log(S/s), with forcing -beta I and coefficient tending to s>0, gives uniform n z->-k/C and hence n(S-s)->-sk/C. Boundary: positive initial S,I, delta<beta A, fixed T>0, q in (0,1); no finite-time or seasonal assertion. The three trajectory RK4/script checks are finite corroboration, not the infinite argument.
